name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Lemon Cherry Runtz
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Lemon Cherry Runtz half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Lemon Cherry Runtz brings a rich, layered profile: sweet cherry and bright citrus up front with candy-like Runtz sweetness and a smooth, creamy finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Lemon Cherry Runtz flavor — sweet cherry and citrus with creamy candy sweetness

My Zypps Lemon Cherry Runtz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
